summary: Calling Date as a function returns a string for the current local date/time and ignores the argument values after normal argument evaluation.

target.notes: Capture the current time and format it with ECMAScript Date string semantics in the host local time zone. Do not use the supplied argument values.

caveats: The exact local time-zone name in the returned string is host-sensitive.
Normal function-call argument evaluation is owned by the canonical function/call rules.

tests.name: arguments are evaluated but values ignored
tests.expected_behavior: prints 1; argument expression side effect occurs even though its value does not affect the Date result
